explanation: Connes (arXiv:2602.04022, §4.2): RH is equivalent to the density in L²(0,1) of the linear combinations Σ c_ν ρ_{θ_ν} with 0 < θ_ν ≤ 1 and Σ c_ν θ_ν = 0, where ρ_θ(x) = {θ/x}. The formal statement takes exactly these combinations (as elements of Lp ℝ 2 on Ioc 0 1, with real c_ν) and asserts Dense. Faithful.
